original_prompt: ONLY one delicate fine silver choker necklace. Standalone accessory catalogue photo, large centered on pure white background. The entire image must contain only the named accessory. Reference is for accessory design, DO NOT recreate the outfit. Absolutely NO DRESS, NO CLOTHING, NO PERSON, no mannequin, no other accessory. Entire object visible with soft natural studio shadows.
